coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan running for air circulation
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a shower
Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster, having tea
Getting dressed for work and packing bag with laptop and notebook
Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and replying to emails
Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
Continuing work at the office, meeting community partners and updating program schedules
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating dinner
Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and wiping kitchen surfaces
Using the computer at the desk lamp for personal admin and planning next day's program activities
Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
Sleeping for the night with the fan on low
